name: Sublime Electric
about:
Sublime Electric has served the Greater Boise area from its Boise, Idaho headquarters since 2007. The company was established as a licensed electrical contractor and has built a reputation for reliable residential and commercial electrical services.

The firm provides a full range of electrical installation, repair, and maintenance services. Its licensed electricians handle lighting upgrades, EV charger installation (Level 1, 2, and 3), electrical panel repair and replacement, whole-home surge protection, and backup generator installation. The team also supports commercial remodeling and construction projects. All work is performed by electricians who have completed apprenticeship training and state licensing requirements.

Sublime Electric serves homeowners and businesses throughout the Boise metro area. Residential customers rely on the company for EV charging solutions, lighting redesigns, panel upgrades, and emergency repairs. Commercial clients engage the firm for new construction wiring, tenant improvements, and ongoing maintenance. The company cites its BBB accreditation and 24/7 emergency response as key factors in customer retention.

The company emphasizes warranted installations, free estimates for major projects, and a community-focused approach that prioritizes safety and code compliance. Its electricians evaluate each job for load capacity and fire risk, particularly when adding circuits or upgrading panels.
